description: This file defines Redux state management for challenge-related UI and logic in a coding challenge platform, including initial state, reducers, epics, and sagas.

methods.name: submitChallenge
methods.description: Handles challenge submission initiation, setting isSubmitting to true.

methods.name: submitChallengeComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of challenge submission, setting isSubmitting to false.

methods.name: submitChallengeError
methods.description: Handles challenge submission error, setting isSubmitting to false.

methods.name: createFiles
methods.description: Creates challenge files with seed contents and editable regions.

methods.name: updateFile
methods.description: Updates a specific challenge file with new contents and editable regions.

methods.name: initVisibleEditors
methods.description: Initializes visible editors, restoring previous state if applicable.

methods.name: resetChallenge
methods.description: Resets challenge files and state to initial seed.

methods.name: setEditorFocusability
methods.description: Sets whether editor can be focused.

methods.name: toggleVisibleEditor
methods.description: Toggles visibility of a specific editor.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Creates a new question with provided description.
